claims.claim: Export of services by an osek murshe is zero-rated (0% VAT) under Section 30 of the Israeli VAT Law, legally distinct from exempt (patur, Sec 31). In the Morning API a 0% line is set via the income-row vatRate field (decimal 0), not a vatType value. The DOCUMENT-level enum DocumentVatType is 0=Default, 1=Exempt, 2=Mixed; the INCOME-ROW enum is a different one, ItemVatType, where 0=Default, 1=Included (VAT included in price), 2=Exempt. Hebrew: יצוא שירותים חייב במע"מ בשיעור אפס לפי סעיף 30 לחוק מס ערך מוסף, להבדיל מעסקה פטורה לפי סעיף 31.
claims.raw_snippet:
Item VAT type calculation.

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| 0 | Default (VAT added based on business type) |
| 1 | Included (VAT included in price) |
| 2 | Exempt (VAT-free) |

claims.claim: The Morning API exposes POST /suppliers and POST /expenses. An expense created with an attached file first becomes an expense draft that must be approved before it counts as an actual expense; an expense created without a file is created immediately.
claims.raw_snippet: With a file (such as a receipt or invoice) - the upload first becomes an expense draft. Review the draft, then approve it to turn it into a regular expense. A draft is simply a pending expense waiting for your approval; until then, it isn't counted as an actual expense.
